claim_boundary: Architecture-development ablation on two already-open ARC1 evaluation tasks. This is not unseen-transfer evidence. Forward-only and forward-backward modes receive identical training pairs, test inputs, grammar, terminal renderer declarations and cost bound. Only the F/B mode intersects forward semantic states with exact backward-preimage fibers derived from visible training outputs. Held-out test outputs enter only post-search for validation.

required_invariants: same exact represented prediction fiber between forward-only and F/B
no held-out output enters either synthesis mode
F/B may prune only via declared exact backward preimage relations
prediction commit only at one exact test-prediction group
